source_observation: One paired sprite: Johnny on right catches adult mermaid against his chest. Her long green tail sweeps left and downward, forked fin at far lower-left, her upper body and yellow hair above his shoulder. We see mainly the back of her head with cyan band; hair hides her eyes. Her near arm extends outward to right with open hand; her other arm folds around Johnny at his shoulder. His far/supporting arm wraps around her upper back and near/supporting arm cups beneath her waist, with continuous shoulder-elbow-hand connections, no extra arms. His hat and most face are hidden behind her hair/torso; bent knees and two bare feet remain visible, staggered under them. White water arcs follow tail.
